actual: C-012-RL1-HR1 request preparation accepts inclusive calendar windows and freezes exact trading-day counts/hashes, but execution additionally requires each observed first/last trading date to equal the raw calendar boundary. Fold-5 starts on the non-trading date 2025-10-01, so fresh process 1 fails before any fit with hmm_risk_rotation_l1_development_fold_invalid. The failure occurs before the enriched exception scope and writes empty failure_evidence. Preserve the approved model, folds, 24-fit count, metrics and selection semantics; align preparation/execution on exact trading-date hash authority and persist typed boundary evidence. No production DB or runtime action.
